metadata.title: OpenAI IPO Fears Hit Oracle and Other Stocks Exposed to the ChatGPT Maker<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
OpenAI IPO Fears Hit Oracle and Other Stocks Exposed to the ChatGPT Maker
Tech stocks were falling on Friday after a report said that ChatGPT developer OpenAI could delay its initial public offering until next year.
